articles.title: Kevin Lamour sacked by FIFA after publicly criticising Infantino's plan
articles.description: FIFA has reportedly sacked the organisation chief operating officer, who last month, published scathing criticism of Gianni Infantino's now-shelved plan to sell a stake in the World Cup to private equity.
